return EXP.map(e=>Math.pow(c,e[0])*Math.pow(m,e[1])*Math.pow(y,e[2]));});\nwindow.A=A;\nconst P=EXP.length;\nconst G=[]; for(let a=0;a<P;a++){G.push(new Float64Array(P));}\nfor(let i=0;i<A.length;i++)for(let a=0;a<P;a++){const v=A[i][a]; for(let b=0;b<P;b++)G[a][b]+=v*A[i][b];}\nwindow.G=G;\nconst Bt=[0,1,2].map(k=>{const v=new Float64Array(P); for(let i=0;i<A.length;i++)for(let a=0;a<P;a++)v[a]+=A[i][a]*T[i][k]; return v;});\nwindow.Bt=Bt;\nconst yy=[0,1,2].map(k=>T.reduce((s,t)=>s+t[k]*t[k],0));\nwindow.yy=yy;\nwindow.solveSub=function(S,k){\n const n=S.length, M=[];\n for(let a=0;a<n;a++){const row=new Float64Array(n+1); for(let b=0;b<n;b++)row[b]=G[S[a]][S[b]]; row[n]=Bt[k][S[a]]; M.push(row);}\n for(let a=0;a<n;a++)M[a][a]+=1e-9;\n for(let col=0;col<n;col++){\n  let p=col; for(let r=col+1;r<n;r++) if(Math.abs(M[r][col])>Math.abs(M[p][col]))p=r;\n  const t=M[col];M[col]=M[p];M[p]=t;\n  const pv=M[col][col]; if(Math.abs(pv)<1e-14) return null;\n  for(let q=col;q<=n;q++)M[col][q]/=pv;\n  for(let r=0;r<n;r++){if(r===col)continue;const f=M[r][col]; if(f===0)continue; for(let q=col;q<=n;q++)M[r][q]-=f*M[col][q];}\n }\n return M.map(r=>r[n]);\n};\nwindow.sseSub=function(S,k){\n const x=window.solveSub(S,k); if(!x)return {sse:Infinity,x:null};\n let s=yy[k];\n for(let a=0;a<S.length;a++){ s-=2*x[a]*Bt[k][S[a]]; for(let b=0;b<S.length;b++) s+=x[a]*x[b]*G[S[a]][S[b]]; }\n return {sse:s,x};\n};\n// greedy forward selection per channel\nwindow.greedy=function(k,maxN){\n let S=[]; const hist=[];\n for(let step=0;step<maxN;step++){\n   let best=null,bi=-1;\n   for(let cand=0;cand<P;cand++){\n     if(S.includes(cand))continue;\n     const r=window.sseSub([...S,cand],k);\n     if(best===null||r.sse<best){best=r.sse;bi=cand;}\n   }\n   S.push(bi); hist.push({n:S.length,sse:best});\n }\n return {S,hist};\n};\nconst g=[0,1,2].map(k=>window.greedy(k,34));\nwindow.greedySel=g;\nreturn g.map(x=>x.hist.filter(h=>h.n%4===0||h.n<5).map(h=>[h.n,+h.sse.toExponential(3)]));\n}');
```

await page.evaluate('() => {\nconst P=window.EXP.length;\nconst W=[250000,308656,40000]; // Lab-space importance of f-residuals for X,Y,Z\nconst S=[[],[],[]];\nconst cur=[0,1,2].map(k=>window.yy[k]);\nconst hist=[];\nfor(let step=0; step<105; step++){\n  let bestGain=-1,bk=-1,bi=-1,bs=null;\n  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){\n    for(let cand=0;cand<P;cand++){\n      if(S[k].includes(cand))continue;\n      const r=window.sseSub([...S[k],cand],k);\n      if(!isFinite(r.sse))continue;\n      const gain=W[k]*(cur[k]-r.sse);\n      if(gain>bestGain){bestGain=gain;bk=k;bi=cand;bs=r.sse;}\n    }\n  }\n  if(bk<0)break;\n  S[bk].push(bi); cur[bk]=bs;\n  hist.push({tot:step+1,sizes:[S[0].length,S[1].length,S[2].length]});\n}\nwindow.jointS=S.map(s=>s.slice());\nwindow.jointHist=hist;\n// evaluate dE00 at several total budgets by replaying\nconst out={};\nfor(const tot of [45,54,60,66,72,78,84,90,96,105]){\n  const h=hist[tot-1];\n  const Ss=[0,1,2].map(k=>window.jointS[k].slice(0,h.sizes[k]));\n  const e=window.evalSel(Ss);\n  out[\'tot\'+tot]={sizes:h.sizes, fitMean:e.mean, fitMax:e.max, ...window.looSel(Ss)};\n}\nreturn out;\n}');
```
